all.name: Wolverine
all.description: Thanks to his regenerative healing factor and berserker rage, the centuries-old Logan can fight through the worst pain to go claw-to-claw with any foe. The Wolverine stands ready to shred through all obstacles in his way with his Adamantium claws.

item.name: Savage Claw
item.description: Slash with Adamantium claws for a <Orange>Claw Strike</>. Unleashing <Orange>Feral Leap</> will enhance it to <Orange>Berserk Claw Strike</> for a brief period.

additional_fields.Attack_Interval: The first three strikes have an interval of 0.27s between them, while the fourth strike has a 0.84s interval from the third strike
additional_fields.Percentage_Damage: Deal damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.057% damage for each point of Rage

item.name: Vicious Rampage
item.description: Dash forward and unleash a <Orange>Claw Strike</>.

additional_fields.Percentage_Damage: Deal damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.057% damage for each point of Rage

item.name: Last Stand
item.description: <Debuff>Launch Up</> enemies ahead and spiral through the air, sweeping up enemies along the path and delivering a devastating impact at the landing point. Impact deals extra damage based on <Orange>Rage</> accumulated.

additional_fields.Impact_Percentage_Damage: Deal damage equal to 10% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.3% damage for each point of Rage

item.name: Phoenix Warrior
item.description: Jean Grey imbues Wolverine and Black Widow with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force. When active, Wolverine's <Orange>Feral Leap</> transforms into <Orange>Phoenix Warrior</>, gaining <Buff>lifesteal</> on all damage dealt and enveloping him with Phoenix flames that scorch nearby enemies, dealing Percentage Damage. Black Widow gains Phoenix Force-empowered bullets; her <Orange>Phoenix Rounds</> explode on impact and heal allies in the blast radius.

additional_fields.Spell_Field_Damage: Deal damage equals to target's 1% Maximum Health per second
additional_fields.Berserk_Claw_Strike_Percentage_Damage: Deal damage equal to 1% of the target's Max Health, with an extra 0.035% damage for each point of Rage.
